evidence_limits: These are separate deterministic host fixtures with mock callbacks and guard regions; they do not compose an actual MIPS execution or emulate one shared in-game frame.
Host output is not evidence of IDO instruction identity, full-unit equality, complete-ROM equality, or in-game behavior.

decision.reason: The bounded semantic and memory-boundary suite passes, but all five investigated functions remain ASM-owned and their candidates lack exact full-unit proof. No production or verifier change is justified.
